No option can be put forward yet because the model could not assess the **monthly churn <4%** limit.

- The price-only comparison held up under the changes tested, but it does not establish compliance with that churn constraint.
- The result rests on four Olumi estimates rather than user evidence, including Pro subscriber count, monthly Pro conversions, monthly churn and other-plan MRR.
- The ordering is most sensitive to the assumed Pro subscriber count; that is an Olumi estimate. This identifies a tested dependency, not an investigation priority.
